# nxos_epbr (Data Source)

This data source can read the Enhanced Policy-Based Redirect (ePBR) configuration on NX-OS devices, including services with layer-3, layer-2 and DPU endpoints, reverse endpoints and probes, service chains, failover groups, policies with matches and sequences, VRF redirection, infra VLANs and interface policy attachments.

## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `failover_groups` (Attributes Map) List of ePBR failover groups.
  - Map key: `name` - The name of the object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--failover_groups))
- `id` (String) The distinguished name of the object.
- `infra_vlans` (Attributes Map) List of ePBR infra VLANs.
  - Map key: `vlans` - Infra VLAN range. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--infra_vlans))
- `interfaces` (Attributes Map) List of ePBR interface policy attachments.
  - Map key format: `<interface_id>;<ip_type>;<reverse>`
  - Key component `interface_id`: Interface ID.
  - Key component `ip_type`: IP type. Choices: `ipv4`, `ipv6`, `l2`.
  - Key component `reverse`: Reverse policy. Choices: `no-reverse`, `reverse`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `policies` (Attributes Map) List of ePBR policies.
  - Map key: `name` - The name of the object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))
- `service_chains` (Attributes Map) List of ePBR service chains.
  - Map key: `name` - The name of the object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_chains))
- `services` (Attributes Map) List of ePBR services.
  - Map key: `name` - The name of the object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services))
- `vrfs` (Attributes Map) List of ePBR VRF redirection policies.
  - Map key: `name` - The name of the object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs))

Read-Only:

Read-Only:

- `ipv6` (Boolean) IPv6 match.
- `load_balance_method` (String) Load-balance method.
- `mask_position` (Number) Load-balance mask position.
- `sequences` (Attributes Map) List of ePBR policy match sequences.

Read-Only:

- `reverse_action` (String) route action for traffic in reverse direction.
- `service` (String) The name of the service.

<a id="nestedatt--service_chains--sequences"></a>

Read-Only:

- `load_balance_method` (String) load-balance method.
- `reverse_action` (String) route action for traffic in reverse direction.
- `service` (String) The name of the service.



<a id="nestedatt--services"></a>
### Nested Schema for `services`

Read-Only:

- `admin_state` (String) Administrative state for EPBR service.
- `connection_mode` (String) Connection mode.
- `dpu_endpoints` (Attributes Map) List of ePBR DPU service endpoints.
  - Map key: `dpu` - Service Module number.
  - Key range: `1`-`16` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services--dpu_endpoints))
- `endpoints` (Attributes Map) List of ePBR service endpoints.
  - Map key: `ip` - The IP address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services--endpoints))
- `hold_down_threshold_count` (Number) Threshold count for EPBR service.
- `hold_down_threshold_time` (Number) Threshold time for EPBR service.
- `l2_endpoints` (Attributes Map) List of ePBR layer-2 service endpoints.
  - Map key: `service_interface` - Service endpoint interface. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--services--l2_endpoints))
- `probe_control` (String) Probe control status.
- `probe_dns_host` (String) DNS host name.
- `probe_frequency` (Number) Probe frequency.
- `probe_http_get` (String) HTTP get string.
- `probe_http_version` (String) HTTP version number, Supported HTTP versions are '1.0' and '1.1'.
- `probe_ip` (String) Probe IP address.
- `probe_port` (Number) The service port number for the LDAP service.
- `probe_protocol` (String) The transfer protocol to be used for data export.
- `probe_retry_down_count` (Number) Probe retry down count.
- `probe_retry_up_count` (Number) Probe retry up count.
- `probe_reverse_source_interface` (String) Resource source interface for probe.
- `probe_source_interface` (String) Probe source interface.
- `probe_timeout` (Number) The amount of time between authentication attempts.
- `probe_track_id` (Number) Probe track ID.
- `reverse_security_group` (Number) reverse security group.
- `security_group` (Number) forward security group.
- `service_interface` (String) Service interface.
- `threshold_high` (Number) min active endpoints to be declared UP.
- `threshold_low` (Number) max active endpoints to be declared DOWN.
- `threshold_up` (Number) Minimum percentage of active endpoints for service to be declared UP.
- `type` (String) The specific type of the object or component.
- `vrf` (String) Identifies the VRF for the NTP providers.
